race.comment: CODENAME MARCUS (12) was solid when resuming with a fourth last start over 2130m at Gloucester Park, beaten 4.5 metres. Will be fitter for that so has winning claims. SEASIDE POND NZ (4) could only manage tenth last start over 2130m at Gloucester Park, beaten 9 metres. Better than the last run suggests; hard to beat this time. MIGHTY MAGICIAN NZ (11) was an impressive winner last start over 2100m at Bunbury, getting home by a neck. Up in class but hard to beat again. Last-start placegetter ARTFUL MAJOR (14) is capable of playing a role again.
